subsystem.name: VehiclePhysics
subsystem.responsibility: Vehicle physics and collision subsystem surface: mode-dispatched transform helpers, collision subsystem global state blocks, collision body/tree scalar updates, per-vehicle telemetry broadcast to process globals, vehicle setup serialization and the auto-load config entry list, physics-system module teardown, and multiplayer session placement state transitions.

summary: The vehicle_physics scope spans ten loosely coupled clusters that share no proven common owner: (1) a mode-dispatched transform helper (0x0040F300) routing through orientation integration or wheel-contact transforms; (2) a multiplayer session placement state machine (0x0042CF10) copying vehicle fields across the shared vehicle array on 4->5->6->7 transitions; (3) text-file vehicle setup serialization (0x0042FD00) and the auto-load vehicle config list service (0x004339E0, 0x00433B60); (4) a physics-file path builder (0x00432CF0); (5) guarded one-time engine initialization (0x004347C0); (6) the physics-system module teardown (0x00431C70) owning global node lists; (7) a collision subsystem global-state initializer family (0x0044CB00, 0x0044D280, 0x0044D880, 0x0044E000, 0x0044E780); (8) collision object/body scalar handling (0x00448DE0 tree propagation, 0x00459950 mass/inverse-mass store) and surface-holder cleanup (0x0044EFE0, 0x0044FBE0); and (9) a two-block per-vehicle telemetry broadcast into fixed process globals (0x004537B0). Most class boundaries and all field semantics are GUESS/DERIVED; the collision object vtable release pattern (+0x20 then +0x8) is consistent with a Direct3D-style unacquire/release but is not proven.

function_roles.role: Mode-dispatched physics transform helper: reads mode at this+0x1C and routes modes 0-5 through orientation integration (callee 0x0045AE00), mode 6 through sub_4F0430 then the wheel-contact transform on this+0x20, otherwise returns the raw mode.

Multiplayer session placement state machine over states 0-7: copies vehicle fields (FieldCopy / FieldCopy_c330) and reorders standings when the session is active, applies transition predicates when it is not, and commits the clamped state to dword_7D00EC.

Serializes a complete vehicle setup configuration into a text file (General header, notes, and labeled key-value sections), min-clamping gear ratios, closing the file, and returning 0 on success or -1 on open failure.
Shuts down the global physics system module: cleans the doubly-linked list header, walks and frees the two global node lists and two flagged allocation blocks, and zeroes all list head/tail state.
Builds a physics file path into a caller buffer from an identifier produced by ShortComputation_0b10 plus the extension at off_5C3F84[0], stripping any existing dot-suffix.

Searches the auto-load vehicle config entry list for the entry matching the settings folder and session-type filter, copying the result path into the caller buffer (or the default path when no match).

Adds or updates a vehicle config entry in the config list object (head 0x1C, tail 0x20, iterator 0x24, count 0x28), linking a 28-byte entry via a 12-byte node, and persists the list through ConfigFileParser.

Guarded one-time engine initialization: initializes engine subsystems twice, invokes a sound-system vtable method, fills a default-float buffer, dispatches the session phase, then sets the guard byte at this+0x2.
Recursive collision-tree mass/contact propagation: blends the stored double at this+0x10 halfway toward this+0x4, recurses into four children at this+0x4C, and follows the sibling link at this+0x5C.
Collision subsystem initializer: seeds dword_7CCFDC (103) and flt_7CCFE0 (0.0) and invokes the shared GlobalInitializer path.
Initializes collision force-feedback and bound globals: 0x007CA57C (61), 0x007CA580 (0), 0x007CA584 (-1082130432), 0x007CA588 (0).
Writes the six-dword collision state block 0x007CCC38 (26) with 0x007CCC3C..0x007CCC4C zeroed.
Writes the six-dword collision comparison/substate block 0x007CCD80 (67) with 0x007CCD84..0x007CCD94 zeroed.
Writes the six-word collision block 0x007CCFEC..0x007CD000: tag 87, four zeroed state words, render state 9000.
Releases a held surface object: zeroes the surface type at this+0x278, calls the surface vtable at +0x20 then +0x8 when non-null, and invalidates the pointer at this+0x4.
Releases a held object: zeroes this+0x2F4, calls the object vtable at +0x20 then +0x8 when non-null, and clears the pointer at this+0x80.
Broadcasts two gated blocks of per-vehicle state from this-struct fields into process telemetry globals: clamped float channels, byte-flag dword dispatches, and bit-gated equality-comparison tiers.
Stores body mass at this+0x180 and inverse mass (1.0 / value) at this+0x188, then forwards a third argument to StructCopyWithReciprocalDivision.

classes.name: PhysicsModeDispatcher
classes.responsibility: Routes a physics/render transform request by a mode selector: orientation integration for modes 0-5 and a wheel-contact transform for mode 6.

classes.name: SessionPlacementController
classes.responsibility: Drives multiplayer session placement state (0-7): copies per-vehicle fields to and from the shared vehicle array and reorders standings on session transitions.

classes.name: VehicleSetupSerializer
classes.responsibility: Serializes a vehicle setup configuration into a text file with labeled sections, gear-ratio min-clamping, and open/close/cleanup lifecycle.

classes.name: PhysicsSystemModule
classes.responsibility: Owns the global physics-system node lists (heads 0x007C7418 and 0x007C7404) and flagged allocation blocks (0x007C73F8, 0x007C73F0) and tears them down on engine shutdown.

classes.name: PhysicsPathBuilder
classes.responsibility: Builds physics file paths from a computed identifier plus an extension string, bounded by a caller-supplied buffer size.

classes.name: VehicleConfigList
classes.responsibility: Maintains the linked list of auto-load vehicle config entries (loaded flag 0x18, head 0x1C, tail 0x20, iterator 0x24, count 0x28) for the active game, with on-demand load, lookup, and add/update persistence.

classes.name: VehicleConfigEntry
classes.responsibility: A single auto-load vehicle config entry: folder path, filter name, session value, and result path.

classes.name: EngineInitializer
classes.responsibility: Performs guarded one-time engine subsystem initialization (engine subsystems, sound interface vtable method, default-float buffer, session phase dispatch) and records completion in a flag byte.

classes.name: CollisionTreeNode
classes.responsibility: Node in a collision contact tree; propagates a mass/contact double toward a target value, recursing into children (this+0x4C) and following the sibling link (this+0x5C).

classes.name: CollisionSubsystem
classes.responsibility: Initializes the collision subsystem's global state blocks: config/render ids (0x007CCC38=26, 0x007CCD80=67, 0x007CCFDC=103, 0x007CCFEC=87), render state (0x007CD000=9000), and force-feedback/bound values (0x007CA57C..0x007CA588).

classes.name: CollisionSurfaceHolder
classes.responsibility: Holds a releasable surface/device object pointer and releases it through its vtable (+0x20, then +0x8) during cleanup, invalidating the pointer afterward.

classes.name: VehicleStateBroadcaster
classes.responsibility: Broadcasts two gated blocks of per-vehicle state (clamped float channels, byte-flag dwords, equality-comparison tiers) from this-struct fields into fixed process telemetry globals.

classes.name: CollisionBody
classes.responsibility: Collision/body object storing body mass and inverse mass for a rigid body.

state_machines.name: SessionPlacement
states: State 0-7: multiplayer session placement phases; state 5 is the session-active vehicle-field-copy phase, state 7 the final/complete phase; state value is stored at this+0x08.
Session-inactive branch: direct targets 2/3/4 and 4->5, 5->6, 6->7 transitions.
transitions: a2 in {2,3,4} or 4->5: call sub_4C01A0(&a2) (non-session target handling).
5->6: when byte_7CEBC4 or championship mode dword_7D0410==4, FieldCopy every vehicle (dword_7C54F0[i]+16436); when championship also ConditionalSeasonDataFree(1).

Session-active and this+0x08==5: FieldCopy every vehicle; on transition to state 7 optionally dev-log, reorder standings (ChampionshipStandingsReOrdering or sub_462E20), FieldCopy_c330 every vehicle, and call sub_4C6F10 on each vehicle.
Commit: this+0x08 = a2 and dword_7D00EC = a2 clamped into [dword_7D00F4, dword_7D00F8]; returns the previous dword_7D00F4.

state_machines.name: PhysicsTransformModeDispatch
states: Default: returns the raw mode value unchanged.
transitions: Mode 6 -> sub_4F0430(a2), then WheelContactTransform(this+0x20); the transform result is returned.

interfaces.name: VehicleSetupWriter
interfaces.purpose: File-backed serialization of a vehicle setup configuration: open, buffered section writes, file close, and conditional cleanup.

interfaces.name: VehicleConfigListService
interfaces.purpose: On-demand auto-load entry list loading, folder/session matching lookup, and add/update with file persistence.

interfaces.name: CollisionSubsystemLifecycle
interfaces.purpose: Initialization and shutdown of collision/physics subsystem global state and owned node lists.

interfaces.name: CollisionBodyPropertySink
interfaces.purpose: Updates collision-body scalar properties: mass/inverse-mass store and tree mass propagation.

interfaces.name: VehicleTelemetryBroadcast
interfaces.purpose: Pushes gated per-vehicle state (clamped float channels, byte flags, equality tiers) into fixed process telemetry globals.

compatibility_contracts.name: VehicleSetupFileFormat
compatibility_contracts.description: Text setup file layout written by VehicleSetupSerializer: a 'General' header, multi-chunk notes section copied 128 bytes at a time, and labeled key/value blocks for symmetric/CG/wedge/tire/fuel/pitstops, fenders/wings, body aero, suspension, controls, engine, gear ratios, driveline, differential, per-wheel corner settings, and a basic setup section; repeated values separated by the word_5C30B4 token; gear ratios min-clamped before the driveline block. The numeric formatting of each parameter is not evidenced by the packet.

compatibility_contracts.name: VehicleTelemetryGlobalState
compatibility_contracts.description: Two gated broadcast blocks in BroadcastVehicleStateToGlobals: each pushes 8 float channels (zeroed when a channel crosses a low or high threshold global) into a fixed output global pair, dispatches 16 byte flags into fixed dword globals via ConditionalFieldSetterWithState, and when the enable word sign bit is set writes equality-comparison booleans from four this-struct dwords against reference globals (bit-gated tiers 0x100/0x200/0x400). A replacement executable must write the same globals when the enable bits are set.

compatibility_contracts.name: CollisionSubsystemGlobalState
compatibility_contracts.description: Collision subsystem global-state blocks established by the CollisionSubsystem initializer family: config/render ids 0x007CCC38=26, 0x007CCD80=67, 0x007CCFDC=103 (with 0x007CCFE0=0.0), block tag 0x007CCFEC=87 and render state 0x007CD000=9000, plus force-feedback/bound values 0x007CA57C=61, 0x007CA580=0, 0x007CA584=-1082130432, 0x007CA588=0. A replacement must seed the same blocks.

compatibility_contracts.name: PhysicsSystemGlobalState
compatibility_contracts.description: Physics-system module owns a doubly-linked list header (0x007C73E8), two node lists (heads 0x007C7418 and 0x007C7404 with their tail words) and two flagged allocation blocks (0x007C73F8, 0x007C73F0) that are released and zeroed on shutdown. A replacement must own and release the same global list state.

compatibility_contracts.name: VehicleSessionPlacementContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Multiplayer placement state 0-7 semantics: session-active state 5 copies every vehicle via FieldCopy(+16436) and transitions to 7 reorder standings and FieldCopy_c330 all vehicles; inactive-session transitions 4->5, 5->6, 6->7 copy vehicle fields (with season-data free when championship dword_7D0410==4); committed state is written to dword_7D00EC clamped into [dword_7D00F4, dword_7D00F8], returning the previous dword_7D00F4. Vehicle array base is dword_7C54F0 with count dword_5C329C.

compatibility_contracts.name: VehicleConfigListFileContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Auto-load vehicle config list persisted via ConfigFileParser to the path buffer byte_7CE498; entries carry a folder path, a filter name, a session value, and a result path, and are matched against the resolved settings folder (dword_7CE5EC) and active game filter (dword_7CE64C dispatch record, filter string at +444) with the session type mapped by dword_7C56A4.

unresolved: The owning object of the mode-dispatched transform helper (0x0040F300) is unknown; why SessionStructureCleanup reaches this render/physics dispatch is not established, and the wheel-contact input contract of WheelContactTransform is outside the function.
Semantics of the placement states 0-7 and the transition-state enum for MultiplayerVehiclePlacement are only partially evidenced (DERIVED from guards and caller context).

sub_462E20 (non-active-session counterpart of ChampionshipStandingsReOrdering) and sub_4C01A0's mutation of the local a2 are unknown; sub_4C01A0 receives &a2 so mutations are invisible in the decompilation.
Global dword_7D2DB0 (race-standings sort buffer) is listed as read but never referenced in the raw source.

Semantics of the setup-file string literals and the numeric formatting of each parameter are inferred only from symbol names; the mapping of the per-wheel write loop to setup fields beyond this+0x16C4/this+0x1704 is not established.
Global jump table jpt_4303CA (0x004305E4) is listed in globals evidence but does not appear directly in the decompiled switch.
ShortComputation_0b10 (0x004B0B10) identifier meaning and the contents of off_5C3F84[0] (presumed extension) are not resolvable from the packet.
unk_8AC388 and dword_8AD298 are listed as accessed globals but absent from the raw source; their roles are unknown.
The collision node list layout (only a next pointer at node+4 observed) and the distinct roles of the two freed node lists / two flagged blocks in shutdownPhysicsSystem are inferred, not proven.
Semantics of the four collision init literals (103, 26, 67, 87, 9000, 61, -1082130432) and the owning subsystem objects are DERIVED from existing analysis, not proven by the packet.

The vtable methods invoked at +0x20 and +0x8 on the surface/held objects (0x0044EFE0, 0x0044FBE0) have no callee addresses; existing analysis interprets them as Direct3D unacquire/Release, which is an interpretation only.
The collision-tree double (0x00448DE0) is described as mass-related but its physical meaning and why children are visited before the sibling are not determinable from this packet.
The D3DShaderConstantSetup source regions and the this+4 substruct passed to sub_44F150 are not in the packet field list; their layouts are unknown here.

The float clamp threshold/output global pairs in BroadcastVehicleStateToGlobals write two output globals per source channel; the downstream subsystem meaning of each output global is not determinable from this function alone.

BroadcastVehicleStateToGlobals and CollisionSubsystemInit write overlapping global ranges (0x007CCC38, 0x007CCFDC, 0x007CCFE0, 0x007CD000 appear in both); the shared ownership of these blocks is not proven.
The recursive child argument passed to PhysicsTreeMassPropagation (the child pointer from this+0x4C) is inferred rather than proven.
Global flt_59E440 is flagged by packet facts but appears nowhere in the raw source for 0x004537B0; its role (possibly an initialization constant for sub_44F150) is not verifiable.
